summary: Find the dense square bitmap in colors 1 and 8. The one yellow at an expanded bounding-box corner identifies the source diagonal; the other three yellows form an L cluster whose quadrant identifies the target diagonal. Clear the input, rotate the colored bitmap clockwise by (target-source) modulo four quarter turns in its original box, and place one yellow at the expanded target corner.
